synthesis.climate_context: Shared Melbourne-metro temperate climate — rain, mud and grit tracked into high-traffic entrances, foyers and washrooms; general Melbourne context, not a suburb-specific measured claim.
synthesis.building_stock: Small suburb whose defining commercial landmarks are Chadstone Shopping Centre (major regional retail centre) and the Chadstone campus of Holmesglen Institute of TAFE (both now technically in Malvern East but retaining the Chadstone name); Monash Freeway runs through the suburb; Waverley Basketball Centre and Matthew Flinders Hotel among landmarks. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chadstone,_Victoria]
